meta.name: PiHub Product V1
meta.description: Unified PiHub design DNA for Investor, Borrower, Advisory and Admin role applications.
source_references: PiHub Investor canonical runtime design system
PiHub Investor authentication and sidebar references
UI/UX Pro Max enterprise fintech guidance

primary.role: primary actions, selected controls and links

secondary.role: global navigation and authentication visual surface

accent.role: active navigation marker and restrained focus detail

neutral.usage: workspace, surfaces, borders, text hierarchy and navigation

color.contrast_strategy: AA-or-better dark-on-light workflow surfaces with high-contrast midnight product chrome

typography.font_style_notes: Institutional sans-serif hierarchy; mono reserved for identifiers and numeric/system contexts.

layout.grid_system: role application content inside a fixed desktop PiHub shell

elevation.depth_cues: border and surface tone before shadow

iconography.preferred_set: existing PiHub icon set until a controlled product-wide migration

motion.easing: cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1) with cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) for transform entrances
motion.entrance_pattern: 8-14px translate plus opacity on authentication and route hierarchy only

components.button_style: 44px minimum, 10px radius, cobalt primary and neutral secondary
components.input_style: 44-48px, visible label, white surface and cobalt focus ring
components.card_style: 16px border-first white surfaces with low shadow
components.navigation_pattern: 232px midnight rail, 72px product topbar, 44px items, 3px cobalt active marker
components.modal_style: elevated white sheet with clear scrim and close action
components.list_style: dense operational rows with restrained hover and readable numeric alignment
components.component_notes: role applications own workflow composition, not shared chrome

visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: shell and headings establish hierarchy; workflow data carries weight

composition.negative_space_role: separates decisions without lowering data density

imagery.illustration_style: abstract product atmosphere on authentication only
imagery.graphic_elements: technical grid, hairlines and restrained signals

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: background/border shift with up to 3px nav translation

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: explain state and next useful action

overview.performance_tier: low in operational UI, optional medium on authentication
overview.primary_technology: CSS/React operationally; optional isolated brand-scene technology

background_effects.description: light and midnight grid fields on PiHub access

particle_systems.description: Borrower uses the static canonical fallback to keep operational dependency surface small

shader_effects.description: Not required for the static product-consistent auth fallback

visual_effects.composite_notes: PiHub role applications share one visual and motion contract. Advanced brand effects, when used by another role, stay isolated to authentication and must retain the same static fallback.
